sanskrit: agnimīḍiṣvāvase gāthābhiḥ śīraśociṣam . agniṃ rāye purumīḍha śrutaṃ naro 'gniḥ sudītaye chardiḥ
english: Praise Agni with hymns for protection, him of the sharp flame. Praise Agni for wealth, O much-praised one; O men, the celebrated Agni is a shelter for brilliant shining.

sanskrit: śrudhi śrutkarṇa vahnibhirdevairagne sayāvabhiḥ . ā sīdatu barhiṣi mitro aryamā prātaryāvabhiradhvare
english: Hear, O Agni of the heard ear, with the gods who bear offerings and who travel together. Let Mitra and Aryaman take their seat on the sacred grass at the sacrifice with those who travel at dawn.

sanskrit: pra daivodāso agnirdeva indro na majmanā . anu mātaraṃ pṛthivīṃ vi vāvṛte tasthau nākasya śarmaṇi
english: Agni, the son of the divine gift, blazes forth like the god Indra in his greatness. He has turned after his mother Earth and stood in the shelter of heaven's vault.

sanskrit: adha jmo adha vā divo bṛhato rocanādadhi . ayā vardhasva tanvā girā mamā jātā sukrato pṛṇa
english: From the earth or from the bright expanse of the vast heaven — grow with this body and this hymn of mine; fulfil what has been born, O Agni of good understanding.

sanskrit: kāyamāno vanā tvaṃ yanmātR^īrajagannapaḥ . na tatte agne pramṛṣe nivartanaṃ yaddūre sannihābhuvaḥ
english: Blazing, you went through the forests when you reached your mothers, the waters. I shall not forget your turning back, O Agni, though you were far away and yet came close.

sanskrit: ni tvāmagne manurdadhe jyotirjanāya śaśvate . dīdetha kaṇva ṛtajāta ukṣito yaṃ namasyanti kṛṣṭayaḥ
english: Manu established you, O Agni, as a light for people for all time. You shine, O Kaṇva; born of cosmic order, nourished, you are the one whom the peoples revere.

sanskrit: devo vo draviṇodāḥ pūrṇāṃ vivaṣṭvāsicam . udvā siñjadhvamupa vā pṛṇadhvamādidvo deva ohate
english: Let the god who gives wealth wish for you a full ladle. Pour it out upward or fill it up — then the god will carry you forward.

sanskrit: praitu brahmaṇaspatiḥ pra devyetu sūnṛtā . acchā vīraṃ naryaṃ paṅktirādhasaṃ devā yajñaṃ nayantu naḥ
english: Let Brahmaṇaspati go forward; let the divine, joyful word go forward. May the gods lead our sacrifice toward the heroic, manly, bountiful one, the lord of the fivefold verse.

sanskrit: ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye tiṣṭhā devo na savitā . ūrdhvo vājasya sanitā yadañjibhirvāghadbhirvihvayāmahe
english: Stand upright for our help, like the god Savitṛ. Stand upright to win the prize when we invoke you with anointed worshippers.

sanskrit: pra yo rāye ninīṣati marto yaste vaso dāśat . sa vīraṃ dhatte agna ukthaśaṃsinaṃ tmanā sahasrapoṣiṇam
english: The mortal who desires to lead toward wealth, who worships you, O Vasu — he gains a hero, O Agni, a reciter of hymns, a nourisher of thousands by his own power.

sanskrit: pra vo yahvaṃ purūṇāṃ viśāṃ devayatīnām . agniṃ sūktebhirvacobhirvṛṇīmahe yaṃsamidanya indhate
english: We choose for you the great Agni of the many peoples, of the clans devoted to the gods — with well-spoken words and hymns — him whom no other kindles at the same time.

sanskrit: ayamagniḥ suvīryasyeśe hi saubhagasya . rāya īśe svapatyasya gomata īśe vṛtrahathānām
english: This Agni is master of heroic valor and of good fortune. He is master of wealth with fine offspring, master of riches with cattle, master of the slaying of Vṛtra.

sanskrit: tvamagne gṛhapatistvaṃ hotā no adhvare . tvaṃ potā viśvavāra pracetā tākṣi yāsi ca vāryam
english: You, O Agni, are the lord of the house; you are the Hotṛ priest at our sacrifice. You are the Potar, all-desired, all-knowing — you cut through and also win what is desirable.

sanskrit: sakhāyastvā vavṛmahe devaṃ martāsa ūtaye . apāṃ napātaṃ subhagaṃ sudaṃsasaṃ supratūrtimanehasam
english: We mortals have chosen you, the god, as a friend for help — child of the waters, bringer of good fortune, rich in fine deeds, with excellent swiftness, without blemish.

sanskrit: iḍaspade namasā rātahavyaṃ saparyatā yajataṃ pastyānām
english: At the seat of Iḷā, with reverence and with offerings freely given, worship the adorable lord of the homesteads.

sanskrit: citra icchiśostaruṇasya vakṣatho na yo mātarāvanveti dhātave . anūdhā yadajījanadadhā cidā vavakṣatsadyo mahi dūtyā3ṃ caran
english: Wondrous is the swelling of the young sprouting one, like one who follows the two mothers to give suck. When he was born without a teat yet he grew strong — at once he goes performing his great mission.

sanskrit: idaṃ ta ekaṃ para ū ta ekaṃ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃ viśasva . saṃveśanastanve3 cāruredhi priyo devānāṃ parame janitre
english: This one light is yours, and another beyond — enter in union with the third light. Being a dweller together, become beautiful in body; be dear to the gods at the highest birthplace.

sanskrit: imaṃ stomamarhate jātavedase rathamiva saṃ mahemā manīṣayā . bhadrā hi naḥ pramatirasya saṃsadyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
english: Let us fashion this hymn of praise for worthy Jātavedas, like a chariot, with intelligence. For blessed is the guidance of this one in his assembly — O Agni, may we not be harmed in your friendship.

sanskrit: mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānaramṛta ā jātamagnim . kaviṃ samrājamatithiṃ janānāmāsannāḥ pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ
english: Agni Vaiśvānara, the head of heaven, the pillar of the earth, born of cosmic order — the gods who were near generated the vessel: the wise one, the sovereign, the guest of peoples.

sanskrit: vi tvadāpo na parvatasya pṛṣṭhādukthebhiragne janayanta devāḥ . taṃ tvā giraḥ suṣṭutayo vājayantyājiṃ na girvavāho jigyuraśvāḥ
english: The gods generated you with hymns, O Agni, like waters from the back of a mountain. The well-praised songs speed you to win the prize — as prize-bearing horses have won a race.

sanskrit: ā vo rājānamadhvarasya rudraṃ hotāraṃ satyayajaṃ rodasyoḥ . agniṃ purā tanayitnoracittāddhiraṇyarūpamavase kṛṇudhvam
english: Make Agni, the Rudra of the sacrifice, the Hotṛ who truly sacrifices for the two worlds, the gold-formed one — make him your refuge, before the unnoticed thunder, for help.

sanskrit: indhe rājā samaryo namobhiryasya pratīkamāhutaṃ ghṛtena . naro havyebhirīḍate sabādha āgniragramuṣasāmaśoci
english: The lord, the mortal's own, is kindled with reverences, whose face is poured with ghee. Men praise him with offerings together in pressing — Agni shines at the forefront of the dawns.

sanskrit: pra ketunā bṛhatā yātyagnirā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti . divaścidantādupamāmudānaḍapāmupasthe mahiṣo vavardha
english: Agni goes forth with his great banner; the bull roars as he fills both worlds. He has lifted up what is highest even from the end of heaven; the great buffalo has grown in the lap of the waters.

sanskrit: agniṃ naro dīdhitibhiraṇyornihito janayanta praśastam . dūredṛśaṃ gṛhapatimathavyum
english: Men have generated the praised Agni, hidden in the two fire-sticks, with their thoughts — seen from afar, the lord of the house, the unwearied one.

sanskrit: yahvā iva pra vayāmujjihānāḥ pra bhānavaḥ sasrate nākamaccha
english: Like great birds spreading their wings upward, his rays stream forth toward the vault of heaven.

sanskrit: pra bhūrjayantaṃ mahāṃ vipodhāṃ mūrairamūraṃ purāṃ darmāṇam . nayantaṃ gīrbhirvanā dhiyaṃ dhā hariśmaśruṃ na vārmaṇā dhanarcim
english: Proclaim the great conquering one, the widely inspiring, the wise among the unwise, the breaker of strongholds — lead him with hymns through the forests; fix thought — he who shines with yellow beard like one clad in armor, brilliant with wealth.

sanskrit: śukraṃ te anyadyajataṃ te anyadviṣurūpe ahanī dyaurivāsi . viśvā hi māyā avasi svadhāvanbhadrā te pūṣanniha rātirastu
english: One of your faces is bright, another is adorable — you are like heaven with your two differently-formed days. For you, self-sustaining one, protect all magic arts — may your bountiful gift be here, O Pūṣan.

sanskrit: iḍāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha . syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme
english: O Agni, accomplish for the one who calls the refreshing, much-wondrous winning of cows, ever-lasting. May there be for us a son, an offspring bearing descendants — O Agni, may that gracious thought of yours be for us.

sanskrit: pra hotā jāto mahānnabhovinnṛṣadmā sīdadapāṃ vivarte . dadhadyo dhāyī sute vayāṃsi yantā vasūni vidhate tanūpāḥ
english: The Hotṛ, being born great, has pierced heaven; the man-seated one has taken his place in the expanse of waters. He who placed himself at the pressed soma dispenses vigor — he who guides riches to the worshipper is a protector of bodies.

sanskrit: pra samrājamasurasya praśstaṃ puṃsaḥ kṛṣṭīnāmanumādyasya . indrasyeva pra tavasaskṛtāni vandadvārā vandamānā vivaṣṭu
english: Let the praising doors wish forward the sovereign, the praised one of the asura power, the laudable male of the peoples — let them wish forward the heroic deeds done, as those of Indra.

sanskrit: araṇyornihito jātavedā garbha ivetsubhṛto garbhiṇībhiḥ . divediva īḍyo jāgṛvadbhirhaviṣmadbhirmanuṣyebhiragniḥ
english: Jātavedas is hidden in the two fire-sticks, like an embryo well carried by pregnant mothers. Agni is to be praised day by day by the wakeful, the offering-bearing human beings.

sanskrit: sanādagne mṛṇasi yātudhānānna tvā rakṣāṃsi pṛtanāsu jigyuḥ . anu daha sahamūrānkayādo mā te hetyā mukṣata daivyāyāḥ
english: From of old, O Agni, you crush the sorcerers; the demons have not conquered you in battles. Burn them along with the stupid ones, the flesh-eaters — may they not escape from your divine weapon.

sanskrit: pra no rāye panīyase ratsi vājāya panthām
english: Speed for us the path to most praiseworthy wealth, to the prize.

sanskrit: yadi vīro anu ṣyādagnimindhīta martyaḥ . ājuhvaddhavyamānuṣakśarma bhakṣīta daivyam
english: If a hero were to follow and a mortal were to kindle Agni — pouring the offering continually, he would enjoy the divine shelter.

sanskrit: tveṣaste dhūma ṛṇvati divi saṃ cchukra ātataḥ . sūro na hi dyutā tvaṃ kṛpā pāvaka rocase
english: Your impetuous smoke moves in heaven, blazing bright and spread wide. For you, O Pāvaka, shine with splendor like the sun, with radiance.

sanskrit: tvaṃ hi kṣaitavadyaśo 'gne mitro na patyase . tvaṃ vicarṣaṇe śravo vaso puṣṭiṃ na puṣyasi
english: You, O Agni, possess fame like a ruler; you govern like Mitra. You, the wide-seeing one, O Vasu, nourish renown as one nourishes prosperity.

sanskrit: prātaragniḥ purupriyo viṣa stavetātithiḥ . viśve yasminnamartye havyaṃ martāsa indhate
english: In the morning, Agni, the much-beloved guest, should be praised throughout the settlements — he in whom, the immortal, mortals kindle the offering.

sanskrit: yadvāhiṣṭhaṃ tadagnaye bṛhadarca vibhāvaso . mahiṣīva tvadrayistvadvājā udīrate
english: What is most to be borne — that goes to Agni of the great hymn, the widely-shining one. Like a great cow, wealth springs from you; prizes spring from you.

sanskrit: viśoviśo vo atithiṃ vājayantaḥ purupriyam . agniṃ vo duryaṃ vacaḥ stuṣe śūṣasya manmabhiḥ
english: Striving for the prize, I praise Agni, the much-loved guest of each and every clan, with the thoughts of the powerful hymn — for you, the praise worthy of a house.

sanskrit: bṛhadvayo hi bhānave 'rcā devāyāgnaye . yaṃ mitraṃ na praśastaye martāso dadhire puraḥ
english: With a great swelling hymn of praise to the divine Agni of the light — him whom mortals have placed in front for praise, like a Mitra.

sanskrit: aganma vṛtrahantamaṃ jyeṣṭhamagnimānavam . ya sma śrutarvannārkṣe bṛhadanīka idhyate
english: We have come to the most Vṛtra-slaying, the greatest, the human Agni — who, the famous one, is kindled in the Nārkṣa asterism with a great visage.

sanskrit: jātaḥ pareṇa dharmaṇā yatsavṛdbhiḥ sahābhuvaḥ . pitā yatkaśyapasyāgniḥ śraddhā mātā manuḥ kaviḥ
english: Born by the higher law, when he came into being together with those who grow together — when Agni was the father of Kaśyapa, Faith was the mother, Manu the sage.

sanskrit: ādityaṃ viṣṇuṃ sūryaṃ brahmānaṃ ca bṛhaspatim
english: Āditya, Viṣṇu, Sūrya, Brahmā, and Bṛhaspati —

sanskrit: ita eta udāruhandivaḥ pṛṣṭhānyā ruhan . pra bhūrjayo yathā pathodyāmaṅgiraso yayuḥ
english: From here they rose up, climbing the back of heaven, climbing upward. Like the many victorious ones, along the path, the Aṅgirases traveled to the sky.

sanskrit: rāye agne mahe tvā dānāya samidhīmahi . īḍiṣvā hi mahe vṛṣaṃ dyāvā hotrāya pṛthivī
english: O Agni, we kindle you for great wealth, for gift-giving. Praise the great bull for the great priestly calling — heaven and earth.

sanskrit: dadhanve vā yadīmanu vocadbrahmeti veru tat . pari viśvāni kāvyā nemiścakramivābhuvat
english: He runs forward when one speaks the word 'brahman' to him — they call it that. He has gone around all poetic wisdom like the felly of a wheel.

sanskrit: pratyagne harasā haraḥ śṛṇāhi viśvataspari . yātudhānasya rakṣaso balaṃ nyubjavīryam
english: O Agni, with your flame strike flame, hear from all around — bend down and break the strength, the might, of the sorcerer demon.

sanskrit: tvamagne vasūṃriha rudrāṃ ādityāṃ uta . yajā svadhvaraṃ janaṃ manujātaṃ ghṛtapruṣam
english: You, O Agni, sacrifice here to the Vasus, to the Rudras, and to the Ādityas. Sacrifice for the people of the perfect rite, the people born of Manu, those who sprinkle ghee.
